concepts.name: 礼林字标
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium BLACK AND WHITE logo concept presentation for 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司, whose public brand is exactly “礼林生态” and English exactly “LILIN ECO”. This company provides software / information technology, engineering services and ecological everyday services. Brand culture: 善心、善念、善行, expressed through thoughtful structure rather than literal religious motifs.
THIS IS DIRECTION A: CUSTOM CHINESE WORDMARK. Main identity consists of beautifully bespoke, readable Chinese lettering “礼林生态”, with 礼林 dominant and 生态 integrated in the same horizontal wordmark at a restrained smaller scale. Carefully draw the characters with contemporary literary character, subtle flared stroke endings, medium weight, open counters, sophisticated editorial optical spacing and gentle stroke details. The correct 礼 has 礻 on the left and 乚 on right; 林 is two 木. The structure must be recognizably correct Chinese, not invented glyphs. A quiet, architectural, humane Chinese logotype, memorable through a few controlled custom stroke connections in 礼林. No pictorial icon beside this main wordmark. Small widely spaced LILIN ECO beneath. This direction must feel typographic and horizontal, not like a geometric tree symbol or a square seal.
Presentation: pristine white landscape board, extremely minimal professional identity design study, flat pure black artwork, ample white margin. Top left small label “A / 礼林字标”. Center show one large main wordmark lockup. Lower left show a much smaller same wordmark as a true reduction test; lower right a small black rectangular swatch with the exact same wordmark reversed in white. Fine unobtrusive divider above lower tests. Typography labels only the A label, no marketing descriptions, no company full name, no slogan. No ornamental icons, no leaves, no mountains, no gradients, no gray, no texture, no photography, no stationery mockup, no 3D, no shadows. All marks crisp, vector-like, balanced, with practical stroke weights for reproduction. Strong typographic craftsmanship rather than generic typeset text. One coherent concept only.

concepts.name: 双木成林
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium BLACK AND WHITE logo concept presentation for Chinese company public brand exactly “礼林生态”, English exactly “LILIN ECO”. Business includes software / information technology, engineering services and ecological everyday services. Underlying culture 善心、善念、善行 should read as mutual support and kindness through form.
THIS IS DIRECTION B: TWIN WOOD STRUCTURAL SYMBOL. Design one very distinctive standalone abstract emblem derived from the Chinese 林: two simplified 木 structures supporting each other. Use just a few bold, equally weighted straight strokes, subtly softened inner junctions and generous negative space. The two structures suggest both connected architectural timber frames and an ordered digital system. Symmetrical or very carefully optically balanced, horizontal and open, highly recognizable at favicon size. One shared linking stroke or negative-space join should make this a crafted unified symbol, not two clipart trees next to each other. Avoid literal leafy tree silhouettes. A contemporary graphic design studio quality compact emblem with strong black silhouette; no enclosing circle, square or seal border. Beside or below it pair a clean neutral Chinese sans-serif wordmark exactly “礼林生态” and small English LILIN ECO. This direction MUST look like a bold geometric symbol with understated sans lettering, entirely different from a literary custom Chinese wordmark and from a traditional seal.
Presentation: pristine white landscape board, flat pure black artwork, lots of white space. Top left small label “B / 双木成林”. Center top show a large standalone symbol, center beneath a horizontal symbol + 礼林生态 wordmark lockup, English small beneath the wordmark. Lower left a very small standalone same symbol with clear negative space, lower right a small solid black swatch showing the same emblem in white. These are scale and reverse tests of the same one concept. No slogan, no long text, no extra unrelated symbol options, no company full name. No leaves, no globe, no swoosh, no mountains, no gradients, no gray, no textures, no photography, no paper mockup, no 3D, no shadows. Crisp vector-like precision and professional spacing.

concepts.name: 现代印记
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium BLACK AND WHITE logo concept presentation for Chinese company public brand exactly “礼林生态”, English exactly “LILIN ECO”, business spans software and information services, engineering, ecological services. Its culture 善心、善念、善行 is thoughtful, warm and practical.
THIS IS DIRECTION C: CONTEMPORARY CHINESE SEAL / OPEN SQUARE SIGNET. Create a distinctive compact asymmetric near-square emblem. An abstract yet intelligible 礼 character is integrated into an OPEN square perimeter: the 礻 strokes form a clear left rhythm and the elegant right 乚 stroke flows into one edge of the square. Keep a deliberate opening in the square so it feels welcoming, not a closed bureaucratic stamp. Bold monoline or subtly varied robust strokes, refined proportions, with strongly controlled white negative space. Inspired by Chinese seal composition but reinterpreted as a clean modern architectural sign, human and calm. It should clearly have a square signet silhouette and be visually entirely different from a horizontal bespoke wordmark or an open twin-tree geometric mark. No actual ink distress, no archaic unreadable maze script, no literal heart. Pair the square emblem with restrained Chinese “礼林生态” in a compact stacked or vertical composition, small LILIN ECO. A modern business identity with understated cultural roots.
Presentation: pristine white landscape board, flat pure black artwork only, generous white space, top left label exactly “C / 现代印记”. Center show the large open-square emblem with its wordmark arranged into an elegant vertical main lockup. Lower left show a small version of the emblem for a favicon/reduction test. Lower right a small black square swatch showing the same exact emblem reversed in white. Only one consistent concept, no additional variants. No culture slogan lettering, no full company name, no extra explanatory copy. No red, no color, no gradients, no gray, no textures, no paper mockups, no photography, no 3D, no shadows, no ornamental border. Crisp vector-friendly execution, proper readable Chinese character forms, practical for small sizes and contracts.
